about.title: More than a holiday, a gentle return to yourself.
about.subtitle: We weave together land, food, ritual and rest into grounded, small-group experiences on the island of Crete.
about.body: Mornings begin with soft light over the hills, the smell of mountain herbs and fresh bread. Days are spent between olive groves, the kitchen, the sea and stillness. Evenings close with simple shared meals and stories.
about.smallBody: We welcome only a handful of guests at a time so the land, the food and the conversations can breathe.

how.title: How your journey with us unfolds
how.subtitle: From first hello to your last cup of mountain tea, we keep things clear, gentle and deeply human.

1.title: Choose what calls you
1.text: Explore our agrotourism & wellness experiences and pick the one that matches your rhythm, season and needs.

2.title: We tailor the details

3.title: Arrive & soften

4.title: Return with roots
4.text: You leave with practices, flavours and stories you can carry home – not just memories on a screen.

hero.subtitle: Oasis is a collection of nature-immersive, small-group experiences where local life, craft, and wellbeing meet. Designed with Cretan hosts and guided by a gentle pace.

card.quote: “Guests come for rest and leave with a new rhythm — one that feels closer to the land and to themselves.”

story.title: Born from the rhythms of local life
story.body1: Oasis began with a simple idea: travel can be gentler, slower, and more rooted in the everyday life of the people who live here. Instead of rushing from sight to sight, we wanted guests to feel the early-morning stillness in the olive groves, the long conversations over food, and the quiet glow of the sea at dusk.
story.body2: Today, we collaborate with growers, cooks, artisans and guides to host small groups in a way that feels like being welcomed into a circle — not just checking into a stay.

1.label: The seed
1.title: A question about pace
1.text: What would travel feel like if we designed it around slowness, care and true connection — rather than schedules and checklists?

2.label: The roots
2.title: Listening to the land
2.text: We spent seasons listening: to farmers, villagers, cooks and healers, shaping experiences around their stories and seasonal rhythms.

3.label: Today
3.title: Hosting with intention
3.text: Each gathering is small, curated and grounded in place. We favour quality over quantity and depth over spectacle.

ethos.title: Gentle travel, real connection
ethos.body: We design each stay as a conversation between land, people and guests. These four principles keep us anchored — in every workshop, meal and walk we host.
ethos.sideText: Think of Oasis as a bridge: between visitors and locals, between fast-paced lives and slower, more grounded ways of being.

sustainability.title: Sustainability
sustainability.text: Low-impact activities, local sourcing, and responsible operations to protect the island we love.

authenticity.title: Authenticity
authenticity.text: Every experience is co-created with Cretan hosts, artisans, and growers — nothing generic.

community.title: Community
community.text: We connect guests and locals through shared meals, workshops, and slow adventures.

wellbeing.title: Wellbeing
wellbeing.text: Mindful practices and nature-first design to help you reconnect with yourself.

day.title: What your stay might feel like
day.subtitle: No two days look exactly the same, but they all share the same ingredients: time, seasonality, and space to simply be.

morning.title: Morning
morning.text: Wake up to soft light, birds, and the smell of mountain herbs. Gentle grounding, slow breakfast, introductions to the day’s rhythm.

daytime.title: Daytime
daytime.text: Herb walks, olive rituals, cooking, tastings, or swims — always in small groups, moving at the pace of conversation and curiosity.

evening.title: Evening
evening.text: Shared meals, reflection, simple rituals. Space to rest, write, or just sit under the sky before another unhurried day.

team.title: Meet the team
team.subtitle: A small, hands-on team working closely with a wider circle of Cretan hosts, farmers, and artisans.

1.name: Stavroula
1.bio: Founded Oasis to share the serenity and wisdom of Crete through intimate, rooted stays.

2.name: Christos
2.bio: Guides mindfulness and holistic practices inspired by the rhythms of nature.

3.name: Maria
3.bio: Nurtures a sense of belonging and meaningful connection between guests and locals.
